activateRegistration(uint256).details: Activates the service and its sensitive components.

bindMultisig(uint256[]).details: Back-fills the multisig <-> service binding for services deployed before this upgrade.

params.serviceIds: Set of service Ids to back-fill.

params.agentParams: Number of agent instances and required bond to register an instance in the service.
params.configHash: IPFS hash pointing to the config metadata.
params.serviceOwner: Individual that creates and controls a service.
params.threshold: Threshold for a multisig composed by agents.
params.token: ERC20 token address for the security deposit, or ETH.

deploy(uint256,address,bytes).details: Creates multisig instance controlled by the set of service agent instances and deploys the service.

params.data: Data payload for the multisig creation.

getOperatorRegisterAgentsNonce(address,u.details: Gets the (operator | service Id) nonce for the register agents message data.

getOperatorUnbondNonce(address,uint256).details: Gets the (operator | service Id) nonce for the unbond message data.

getRegisterAgentsHash(address,address,ui.details: Gets the register agents message hash for the operator.

params.agentIds: Agent Ids corresponding to each agent instance address.
params.agentInstances: Agent instance addresses operator is going to register.
params.bondToken: Bond token of the service: the ERC20 token, or ETH_TOKEN_ADDRESS for a native-token service.
params.deadline: Last timestamp at which the message can be used.
params.maxBond: Maximum total bond for this registration, summed over the listed agent instances.
params.nonce: Nonce for the register agents message from the pair of (operator | service Id).

getUnbondHash(address,address,uint256,ui.details: Gets the unbond message hash for the operator.

params.deadline: Last timestamp at which the message can be used.
params.nonce: Nonce for the unbond message from the pair of (operator | service Id).

isOperatorHashApproved(address,bytes32).details: Checks if the hash provided by the operator is approved.

returns._0: True, if the hash provided by the operator is approved.

operatorApproveHash(bytes32).details: Approves message hash for the operator address.

params.agentIds: Canonical Ids of the agent correspondent to the agent instance.

registerAgentsWithSignature(address,uint.details: Registers agent instances of the operator by the service owner via the operator's pre-signed message hash.

params.agentIds: Canonical Ids of the agent correspondent to the agent instance.
params.bondToken: Bond token the operator signed for: the service ERC20 token, or ETH_TOKEN_ADDRESS for a        native-token service.
params.deadline: Last timestamp at which the signed message can be used.
params.maxBond: Maximum total bond the operator signed for, summed over the listed agent instances.
params.operator: Operator address that signed the register agents message hash.
params.signature: Signature byte array associated with operator message hash signature.

returns.success: True, if the the function executed successfully.

setIdentityRegistryBridger(address).details: Sets identity registry bridger contract address.

params.newIdentityRegistryBridger: New identity registry bridger contract address.

setOperatorWhitelist(address).details: Sets the operator whitelist contract address.

unbond(uint256).details: Unbonds agent instances of the operator from the service.

returns.refund: The amount of refund returned to the operator.

unbondWithSignature(address,uint256,uint.details: Unbonds agent instances of the operator by the service owner via the operator's pre-signed message hash.

params.deadline: Last timestamp at which the signed message can be used.
params.operator: Operator address that signed the unbond message hash.
params.signature: Signature byte array associated with operator message hash signature.

returns.refund: The amount of refund returned to the operator.
returns.success: True, if the function executed successfully.

update(address,bytes32,uint32[],(uint32,.details: Updates a service in a CRUD way.

params.agentParams: Number of agent instances and required bond to register an instance in the service.
params.configHash: IPFS hash pointing to the config metadata.
params.threshold: Threshold for a multisig composed by agents.
params.token: ERC20 token address for the security deposit, or ETH.

bindMultisig(uint256[]).notice: Permissionless and idempotent: for each service Id it records only that service's OWN current         multisig (read from the registry), and skips entries with no multisig or already bound. It can         therefore only ever write the registry's true binding and cannot forge a foreign one. Anyone may         call it to back-fill the existing fleet in bulk.

changeImplementation(address).notice: Make sure implementation contract has function to change its implementation.

deploy(uint256,address,bytes).notice: Redeployment with a different multisig also clears any authorization retained by the previous multisig         from before termination cleanup was introduced, provided it belongs to this service's identity.

getRegisterAgentsHash(address,address,ui.notice: Each array is hashed as EIP-712 prescribes: keccak256 of the concatenated 32-byte encodings of its         elements, with no offset or length prefix.

registerAgentsWithSignature(address,uint.notice: Note that this function accounts for the operator being the EOA, or the contract that has an         isValidSignature() function that would confirm the message hash was signed by the operator contract.         isValidSignature() receives the 65 signature bytes with the operator address in r, so a wallet that         reads owner signatures from them, such as Safe, uses the pre-approved hash path; see _verifySignedHash().         Otherwise, if the message hash has been pre-approved, the corresponding map of hashes is going to         to verify the signed hash, similar to the Safe contract implementation in v1.3.0:         https://github.com/safe-global/safe-contracts/blob/186a21a74b327f17fc41217a927dea7064f74604/contracts/GnosisSafe.sol#L240-L304         Also note that only the service owner is able to call this function on behalf of the operator.

unbondWithSignature(address,uint256,uint.notice: Note that this function accounts for the operator being the EOA, or the contract that has an         isValidSignature() function that would confirm the message hash was signed by the operator contract.         isValidSignature() receives the 65 signature bytes with the operator address in r, so a wallet that         reads owner signatures from them, such as Safe, uses the pre-approved hash path; see _verifySignedHash().         Otherwise, if the message hash has been pre-approved, the corresponding map of hashes is going to         to verify the signed hash, similar to the Safe contract implementation in v1.3.0:         https://github.com/safe-global/safe-contracts/blob/186a21a74b327f17fc41217a927dea7064f74604/contracts/GnosisSafe.sol#L240-L304         Also note that only the service owner is able to call this function on behalf of the operator.

update(address,bytes32,uint32[],(uint32,.notice: Updates clear parameters for agent Ids omitted from the current configuration: they are passed to the         registry with zero slots, so no parameters of an omitted agent Id remain to be registered against.         This does not automatically clear parameters left by earlier updates, whose agent Ids are no longer in         the current configuration; owners can explicitly include those agent Ids with zero slots when updating         in PreRegistration.
